content: Common backtesting failure modes: overfitting (too many parameters tuned on too little data -- train Sharpe 2.5/test Sharpe 0.3 is the classic tell), data-snooping bias from testing many variants and only reporting the winner, ignoring fees/spreads/slippage, and accidental future-data leakage. Sharpe > 3 is a red flag for overfitting; mitigate via walk-forward/out-of-sample validation and realistic cost modeling.
